proposals.name: llm_volume_confirmed_trend_efficiency_a4588aad
proposals.economic_logic: Combines price path smoothness with trading volume validation to isolate sustained institutional accumulation. Efficient price movement backed by high volume indicates true directional consensus rather than noise.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: ETF sectors exhibiting both high trend efficiency and strong volume confirmation over 20 days will outperform cross-sectionally due to persistent institutional flows.
failure_modes: Abrupt macro sentiment shifts triggering immediate sector rotations
False breakouts in low-liquidity market regimes

proposals.name: llm_short_term_reversal_volatility_adjusted_4fb816b5
proposals.economic_logic: Normalizes 5-day mean reversion signals by 20-day historical volatility to identify overextended price moves relative to noise level, adjusting risk exposure dynamically.

proposal_metadata.hypothesis: Sectors experiencing sharp 5-day price dips relative to their underlying volatility will experience stronger short-term mean reversion excess returns over 5 days.
failure_modes: Strong fundamental earnings downgrades causing persistent trending behavior
Systemic liquidity shocks causing multi-week momentum continuation
